## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or design decision
when relevant; include the source when citing a numbered acceptance case.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks actually performed and their outcomes.
State any unrun checks and platform limitations.

## Compatibility and follow-up

Describe protocol, project-format, migration, localization, or platform impacts
when applicable. Note unresolved limitations, or write "None".
